description: This Java class 'Log' provides a wrapper around Android's logging utility, using reflection to control log stripping and formatting log messages. It defines methods for different log levels and manages external method references for logging.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class providing reflection-based logging methods with control over log levels and message formatting.

methods.name: initLogging
methods.description: Initializes reflection Method objects for Android Log class methods.

methods.name: getThrowableToLog
methods.description: Extracts Throwable object from method arguments if present.

methods.name: formatLog
methods.description: Formats log message with parameters, considering Throwable presence.

methods.name: logWithMethod
methods.description: Invokes the appropriate log method via reflection with formatted message.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message if loggable at VERBOSE level.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message if loggable at DEBUG level.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message if loggable at INFO level.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message, with overload for Throwable.
